about: I design and build software for the web — product interfaces, design systems, and the architecture underneath them. Twenty years of it, most recently at Modern Treasury and Metropolis. Next.js and TypeScript day to day, WebGL and motion when the work calls for it. Based in Las Vegas. I also play poker and take [photos](#photos).
working: [THIRD INDEX](https://thirdindex.co/) is my studio — marketing sites, ecommerce and editorial platforms, and web applications for startups, brands, and agencies. Fractional or per project. Taking on new work now.
clients: Amazon, Pentagram, Elara, One/Of, Grey, Knoll.
